name: SpatialBench Verified
intro: SpatialBench Verified 是 LatchBio 开发并由 Claude Sonnet 5 系统卡披露的空间转录组学分析评测变体，包含 115 个经过外部验证的问题，要求模型根据样本分析结果回答生物学问题。
build_method: 外部验证；来源、标注与评分构建未披露
metric: 系统卡未披露评分协议
task_type: 生物信息学问答, 数据分析
eval_feature: 空间转录组学分析, 外部验证
build_method_en: External validation; sourcing, annotation, and scoring construction not disclosed
intro_en: SpatialBench Verified is a LatchBio spatial-transcriptomics evaluation variant documented in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card. It contains 115 externally validated problems that require models to answer biological questions from sample-analysis results.
metric_en: Scoring protocol not disclosed in the system card

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Claude Sonnet 5 System Card Section 8.14.2 LatchBio Bioinformatics, p.142. SpatialBench Verified is a LatchBio evaluation variant documented only in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card, not in a standalone benchmark paper. The card says it tests analysis of spatial-transcriptomics data across 115 externally validated problems and requires models to answer biological questions about a sample from the analysis results. The cited source does not disclose how problems were sourced or annotated, dataset splits, prompts, tools, reference-answer format, per-item rubric, or aggregation formula. The diagram therefore preserves the disclosed scope and validation facts while marking the unavailable build and scoring details explicitly instead of inventing them.
